- **What's missing:** Pine Crossing isn't tied to a site code, address or separate site name anywhere Pree can see. That Jun 9 thread is the only place it comes up. I told her to ask Hollis or the customer's store ops if the account sheet needs a formal site ID.
- **One slip:** my reply also says Pine Crossing isn't on the onboarding store list. That list is in an onboarding ticket (SUP-5102) that isn't among the files Pree can see, so I shouldn't have used it. It only reveals that Pine Crossing isn't on the list, Pree is on the Central team, and there's no money in it. Still, it went beyond what she could see herself.
